problem_text:
A logistics company needs to coordinate 10 delivery routes through 10 distribution centers.

Each route consists of a sequence of handling stages represented as pairs (Center, Duration),
where each pair specifies the distribution center where the stage must occur and the time required for processing.
The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence in which the handling stages must be completed.

Route details:
* R1 requires the sequence: (C4, 10) → (C6, 9) → (C3, 3) → (C1, 4) → (C8, 1) → (C10, 8) → (C7, 2) → (C9, 4) → (C2, 8) → (C5, 5)
* R2 requires the sequence: (C10, 10) → (C5, 1) → (C9, 8) → (C1, 1) → (C6, 3) → (C8, 2) → (C3, 1) → (C2, 5) → (C7, 5) → (C4, 2)
* R3 requires the sequence: (C2, 10) → (C10, 10) → (C4, 8) → (C7, 1) → (C5, 9) → (C6, 10) → (C1, 8) → (C3, 7) → (C9, 5) → (C8, 10)
* R4 requires the sequence: (C1, 1) → (C4, 5) → (C6, 10) → (C3, 9) → (C7, 4) → (C2, 5) → (C9, 3) → (C10, 10) → (C5, 1) → (C8, 7)
* R5 requires the sequence: (C5, 10) → (C4, 6) → (C1, 5) → (C8, 7) → (C10, 9) → (C2, 2) → (C9, 9) → (C3, 8) → (C7, 4) → (C6, 5)
* R6 requires the sequence: (C5, 9) → (C1, 5) → (C6, 5) → (C10, 7) → (C3, 8) → (C7, 2) → (C8, 2) → (C9, 7) → (C2, 4) → (C4, 3)
* R7 requires the sequence: (C4, 9) → (C5, 8) → (C6, 6) → (C8, 2) → (C9, 4) → (C10, 10) → (C7, 8) → (C3, 5) → (C2, 10) → (C1, 2)
* R8 requires the sequence: (C1, 2) → (C10, 8) → (C2, 5) → (C6, 8) → (C7, 8) → (C8, 1) → (C4, 5) → (C3, 9) → (C5, 9) → (C9, 8)
* R9 requires the sequence: (C6, 10) → (C8, 4) → (C3, 1) → (C10, 5) → (C5, 2) → (C2, 7) → (C1, 6) → (C7, 7) → (C4, 6) → (C9, 3)
* R10 requires the sequence: (C10, 8) → (C7, 2) → (C8, 6) → (C2, 5) → (C4, 10) → (C9, 3) → (C5, 5) → (C1, 1) → (C6, 4) → (C3, 9)

Each handling stage must run continuously once initiated and cannot be interrupted,
and each distribution center can only accommodate one handling stage at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing sequence of all handling stages across the distribution centers
so that the total completion time of all delivery routes is minimized.
